To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the angular distributions for the Drell-Yan process at the NLO accuracy have been computed for the first time, and the corresponding helicity densities are given for both Z and W production.

(1) the NLO angular distributions of the Drell-Yan process can be obtained using the subtraction method; (2) the NLO helicity density matrices can be obtained by the same method; (3) we provide the numerical results for the Drell-Yann process in the form of a C++ code.
the angular distribution of the Drell-Yan process is sensitive to the NLO corrections and that the helicity density matrix is a convenient tool to study the angular distribution of D-Y process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the angular distribution of the Drell-Yan pair production in the framework of QCD.
the angular distribution of the Drell-Yan process.
the study of the angular distribution of the lepton pair in the reaction e+e−→μ+μ−γ.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present work has provided a complete and systematic treatment for the NLO QCD corrections for Drell-Yan process in MC event generators.
the NLO corrections in the gluon-quarks induced process of Drell-Yans lepton pair production are not large enough to be of any significance.
the angular distribution of the lepton pair is a very good tool for the study of the angular distribution of Drellyan lepton pair.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided an efficient and reliable method to compute the angular distribution and helicity density matrix at NLO in Monte Carlo event generators.
the helicity density matrix is a very useful tool to describe the spin information of a particle and the spin correlation between the particles.
we give the formulae for the angular distribution for all the NLO corrections in the Drell-Yan production.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the angular distribution of NLO corrections to the Drell-Yan cross section can be expressed as a linear combination of the Born cross section, the NLO corrections to unpolarized cross section, and the NLO corrections in the limit of vanishing transverse momentum.
, the angular distributions are not affected by the choice of the factorization scale, which is not the case in the case of the total cross-section.
the angular distribution of the lepton pair is sensitive to the NLO corrections.
